reviewNotes: Twenty-five object strings covering crafting resources, flooring, shellfish, coconut, coffee, cooked food, a forged ring, mushrooms, and breakfast were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover established recipe and fish names, planting and keg instructions, material descriptions, item gender, preserved punctuation, and approved glossary terminology; both found no remaining objective issue.

Cloth_Description.source: A bolt of fine wool cloth.
Cloth_Description.translation: Un val de stofă fină din lână.

Coal_Description.source: A combustible rock that is useful for crafting and smelting.
Coal_Description.translation: O rocă combustibilă, utilă la confecționare și topire.

CobblestonePath_Description.source: Place on the ground to create paths or to spruce up your floors.
CobblestonePath_Description.translation: Așaz-o pe sol pentru a crea poteci sau pentru a-ți înfrumuseța podelele.

Coconut_Description.source: A seed of the coconut palm. It has many culinary uses.
Coconut_Description.translation: O sămânță a palmierului de cocos. Are numeroase întrebuințări culinare.

Coffee_Description.source: It smells delicious. This is sure to give you a boost.
Coffee_Description.translation: Miroase delicios. Cu siguranță îți va da energie.

CoffeeBean_Description.source: Plant in spring or summer to grow a coffee plant. Place five beans in a keg to make coffee.
CoffeeBean_Description.translation: Planteaz-o primăvara sau vara pentru a crește o plantă de cafea. Pune cinci boabe într-un Butoi ca să faci cafea.

Coleslaw_Description.source: It's light, fresh and very healthy.
Coleslaw_Description.translation: Este ușoară, proaspătă și foarte sănătoasă.

CombinedRing_Description.preservationReason: The description consists only of an ellipsis, so preserving it exactly retains the intended absence of descriptive text.

CommonMushroom_Description.translation: Are un gust ușor de nucă și o textură plăcută.
